pitches.subject: Hammered brass planters from Moradabad for Kayu Home
pitches.body:
Hello Kayu Home team,

I came across your Nkuku Atsu and Antique Brass Tembesi Etched planters, alongside your Asian-sourced antique furniture. Handmade brass seems a natural fit for your range, so I wanted to introduce our hammered brass planter in a hammered gold finish, made by metalworkers in Moradabad.

Under the India-UK CETA, these planters enter the UK at zero import duty, with proof of origin supplied. Our minimum order is 300 pieces, and our quote range is £6.72–£12.10 FOB per piece.

We offer a variant with drainage holes and a plug. Or, if you prefer the planter as a cachepot, we label it clearly as having no drainage so your customers know what they are buying.

Would you like a sample and our catalogue? I would be glad to send them.

Kind regards,
[Your name], [Company], Moradabad
